authored.remainingFailure: One instruction is still missing in overall text extent. The first-item purchase interval is two instructions short while other regions contribute one extra; register, control-flow and address differences remain broad. GCC schedules the category-cursor load into the offset helper's call delay slot, before the helper, unlike retail's post-call load. The 64-byte switch table remains separately assembly-owned with no approved auxiliary contract for this target; original ASM stays production and the two-member shop wave has not run its final verifier.
authored.sourceChange: Publish selected_id inside each first-item branch, before the special-price call on the equipment path; load the helper's selected-ID argument from the published global; use a separately addressed volatile status-byte read for retail's post-comparison reload; read the equipment branch's category-row index after its category-offset helper; and store price inside each branch instead of at their join. Retain the full sixteen-state source, branch-local signed row loads, explicit case-7 index and pointer, single case-12 guard and independently addressed inventory regions.
